A crystal of sodium chloride is dropped into a beaker of water.
Over time, the sodium chloride particles become evenly distributed throughout the water.
Which processes occur in this experiment?
A
both dissolving and diffusion
B
dissolving only
C
diffusion only
D
neither dissolving nor diffusion
subject: Chemistry
